digest.component_or_area: LLM gate verdict signing and provenance tracking
propositions: Signed verdicts currently record only a model string and cannot distinguish between verdicts produced by different providers (Anthropic, Bedrock, Ollama) even though all are signed

A new additive provider_provenance object must be stamped alongside the existing model field to carry provider, model, endpoint_host, tier, and effective capabilities for each verdict without breaking backward compatibility

The provenance assembly must reuse the capabilities record already computed once per run (runner.py:357) rather than recomputing it, to ensure the stamped record matches the one that actually drove the run
The endpoint_host field must extract only the hostname via urlparse().hostname, never netloc, to prevent credential material from base_url or api_key appearing in the signed payload

The provider_provenance key must be threaded from runner.run() outputs through finalize_verdict in all call sites (plan-review coach step, completion gate, recovery paths) to reach the three sidecar payload writers
Legacy sidecar payloads lacking provider_provenance must continue to load and verify, making this a strictly backward-compatible additive change
